name: Log
overview: The biblical term 'log' refers to a specific measure for liquids, approximately a pint in volume, as demonstrated in Leviticus 14 where it is consistently associated with offerings of oil. The passages highlight the log of oil being used in ceremonial offerings, including wave offerings and trespass offerings, underscoring its role in the prescribed rituals for worship and atonement. This measure signifies the careful and exact nature of the sacrificial system given by God to Israel.
